page.layout: One printed page, no margins. Full-width title block at the top (ornamental border, then two centred capitalised lines of heading). Below, centred verse stanzas with woodcut initials at left, attributions set right, and a signature at the foot. No running head, page number or notes.

main_text.head: MERITISSIMO I. V. CANDIDATO BALTHAZAR ROYER. ILLVSTRIS AC GENEROSVS CLERICADVS A VERGY.

p.i: Quid referas Royere Iouis sacra templa trisulci? An quia Bellonae frater vbiq; viget? Olim Mars paci cesserit: pax Marte recessit Postea: Nunc Bello quod fuit ante manet.

main_text.head: EIDEM

p.i: Exuuium Indutum fremebundi haud ante Leonis Vxor ouans vidit Deyanira virum. Nec prius Alcmenae Lernam tremefecerat arcus Filius, effusus, quàm sit vbiq; cruor. Hic certamen adest; pugna, victoria praesto est. Quod nequeat vinci, nam Lotharingus habet.

main_text.p: Ludouicus à Burgundia D. à Niuuerae & Rhyttem.
main_text.head: EIDEM,

p.i: Aspice qui summo, ter binus amplius annis Libauit sacros, excoluitq; libros En Alia, Iuris Doctrina nempe, peritus Prodit quem haec merito docta Palaestra tenet. Hunc num binus honos, bino qui gurgite binas Eduxit Musas, praemia bina manent? Binum bina manet studium, nam doctus utroq; Clarescit, merces, Iustitia atq; Deus. Praemia sume Royer tantu iam consona curis Proemia iam votis consona sume mei.

main_text.head: EIDEM.

p.i: Si tibi quid Royere rei cum Iustiniano? Pone metus; nouit nam dare cuiq; suum. Conduxit ne operas? precium dabit Inde Locatis Actio: sed quod erit? Laurea, Doctor eris.

page.notes: The first word of each stanza is a woodcut initial, joined to the following word (Quid, Exuuium, Aspice, Si). Stanza openings "Q" and "E" are read from the woodcut letter and the printed first word. The word after "St" in the fourth stanza is doubtful and read as Si. "binus" in the third stanza and "Gatinoys" are read as printed, with no certainty about the macron or the final letters. Woodcut initials and ornamental border are not transcribed.
